method: Read-only active JSON plus four SQLite records and their visual_links; no search/model/rebuild executed.
limits: Original returned hit_frame_id was not saved; possible hit frames are inferred from UI floor-to-second display, not reconstructed ranking.
SQLite resolved entity snapshot is read as stored, not recomputed; active window and identity digests are independently checked.
Missing region means no stored detection/binding evidence, not proof that no person is visible.
E01 second 608 is a known target interval, not a saved result hit.

conclusions: The three saved result UI intervals have zero stored identity regions; their displayed names are window-level context from earlier frames.
The known E01 true target frame at 608483 was sampled but its stored detector returned zero boxes although two small figures are visible.
E08 contains visible small figures on playground equipment in front of the distant tower, so person presence alone does not prove the requested on-tower relation.
All examined resolved identity entries are candidates; there are no verified character identities in these windows.
Same-frame identity must not be fabricated from window-level names, and a hard same-frame identity gate would reject the known E01 target.

sanitization.scope: Absolute local filesystem paths replaced with logical library/workspace paths; no media or model cache is bundled.
